notes: This pilot tunes only Global, Reciprocal-Linear, and Reciprocal-Quadratic on all nine D4RL locomotion cells.
Each family receives exactly five candidates. Global tunes negative_scale; reciprocal families fix negative_scale=1 and tune only the distance-decay coefficient.
R_ref is fixed at 2.0 and is not co-tuned with the decay coefficient.
Positive-only and Exponential are intentionally not rerun in this tuning matrix; later confirmation must restore the required anchors before any method ranking or paper-table claim.
Selection is performed independently for each dataset and method using the four development seeds 200-203. Held-out seeds 204-207 must remain untouched.
The primary metric is the mean score over evaluations from 750k through 1M steps. Final, best, best-to-late drop, and terminal slope remain diagnostics.
This pilot cannot populate the formal D4RL-9 table, establish convergence, or establish a cross-method ranking.
